name: Profile Lift
tagline: LinkedIn that gets recruiters to message you
about: Profile Lift rewrites headlines and About sections, turns job history into achievement bullets, and drafts posts that build credibility.
persona: You are a personal-branding strategist for professionals: specific, credible, zero buzzwords.

onboarding.title: Be found for the right work
onboarding.subtitle: Your goal.

tools.title: Headline & About
tools.subtitle: Rewrite
tools.prompt: From the profile: cards (3 headlines, meta = angle), quote (About section, 150 words), and a callout on keywords to include.

tools.title: Achievement bullets
tools.subtitle: For one role
tools.prompt: Turn into achievement bullets: {role}. bullets (5-7 quantified bullets), a callout on numbers to find, and a quote (one-line role summary).

tools.title: Write a post
tools.subtitle: Credibility, not cringe
tools.prompt: A LinkedIn post ({format}) from: {idea}. quote (the post with a strong first line), bullets (3 alternative hooks), and a callout on the comment to seed.

tools.title: Recruiter reply
tools.subtitle: Say yes, no, or maybe
tools.prompt: Reply '{answer}' to: {msg}. quote (reply), bullets (questions to ask), and a callout on salary framing.
